capabilities: Create plays on pre-drawn football fields with players positioned by formation
Draw routes and blocking symbols on selected players
Build and edit a formation library per team and format
Tag plays and filter the playbook panel by name, formation or tag
Export and import playbooks as .playbook.json files and export playbooks as PDF
extras: PDF export requires a computer; browsing, drawing, importing and sharing work on mobile. Everything is stored as plain files in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw or organize football plays, and diagramming a field and players from scratch in a drawing tool is tedious.

relations.evidence: Plays are drawn with the Excalidraw plugin, with the field and players already in place.

summary: Football playbook manager that creates teams, formations and plays drawn with Excalidraw on pre-drawn fields, with routes, tags, mirroring and PDF export.
